scripts.deploy: npm run build-dev && npm run copy-dev && spicetify config extensions sidebar-customizer.js && spicetify apply && spicetify enable-devtools
scripts.deploy-dist: npm run build && npm run copy-dist && spicetify config extensions sidebar-customizer.js && spicetify apply
scripts.local: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run copy-dist && spicetify config extensions sidebar-customizer.js && spicetify apply && spicetify enable-devtools
scripts.undeploy: rm -rf `spicetify path userdata`/Extensions/sidebar-customizer.js && spicetify config extensions sidebar-customizer.js- && spicetify apply
